procedural_matters: GER 66 was represented by Xanthia Berger.
ANG 101 was represented by Vanio Domingo.
Karl Perscheid (GER 36328) gave evidence as a witness.
facts: During race 9 of Vaurien, the wind was 11 to 12 knots with 1 to 1.5 meter waves.
On the beat to windward shortly after the start, GER 66 was sailing on close-hauled starboard tack.
ANG 101 was sailing on close-hauled port tack on a converging course with GER 66.
When GER 66 was about 2 to 3 meters from ANG 101 she bore away and passed half a boat length behind ANG 101.
If GER 66 would not have changed the course, the contact would have occurred between the bow of GER 66 and starboard aft quarter of ANG 101.
There was no contact or injury.
conclusions: ANG 101 on port tack failed to keep clear of GER 66 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
